headlines.title: Democrat Scott Colom wins Mississippi Senate seat, breaking GOP’s grip on the state
headlines.description: Colom pulled off an upset over Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith, becoming the first Democrat elected to the Senate in Mississippi since 1982.

headlines.title: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent moves to a military base amid Iranian threats
headlines.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent moved to a military base following threats from Iran, according to a source familiar with the situation.

headlines.title: Nvidia’s Jensen Huang Steps Down as CEO Amid Scandal
headlines.description: Jensen Huang, the billionaire CEO of Nvidia, has resigned effective immediately. The resignation comes amid growing fallout over the tech titan’s admitted affair with an alleged Chinese spy and another reported relationship with one of his own executives. The company’s chief financial officer Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO.

headlines.title: Hegseth Reprimanded at Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
headlines.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is facing new criticism after a stunning moment at Arlington National Cemetery on Veteran’s Day when an Army sentinel guarding the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier reprimanded Hegseth and others, telling them to be respectful of the sacred place. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Mississippi Elects First Black Senator in More Than 140 Years
headlines.description: Democrat Scott Colom defeated incumbent Republican Cindy Hyde-Smith in Mississippi’s race for U.S. Senate, making Colom the state’s first Black senator elected since Reconstruction and its first Democratic senator in nearly 45 years. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Early midterm voting data shows enthusiasm ahead of election day
headlines.description: With millions of Americans having already voted, NBC News Director of Elections John Lapinski analyzes early midterm voting data and key races to watch on election night.

headlines.title: Ukraine faces new Starshield disruptions as Trump envoys meet with Putin
headlines.description: Hours after an American delegation touched down in Moscow for peace talks, Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said his country’s military had experienced a renewed wave of “significant disruptions” to the Starshield satellite internet service, hampering its ability to defend itself against Russia.

headlines.title: Sen. Richard Blumenthal ordered to preserve documents from inquiry into Trump ballroom
headlines.description: The official’s letter comes on the day the White House told congressional Democrats that investigations into the administration could be a crime.

headlines.title: Miller’s moment: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, we explore how Stephen Miller’s appointment as White House chief of staff is already making waves across Washington.

headlines.title: Pete Hegseth and others reprimanded by guard at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier
headlines.description: An Arlington National Cemetery guard told the defense secretary and his companions to maintain a respectful atmosphere during a Veterans Day visit.

headlines.title: White House warns congressional Democrats: Investigating us may be a crime
headlines.description: Rep. Robert Garcia, the incoming House Oversight Committee chair, noted that the Constitution grants Congress “latitude to conduct investigations.”

headlines.title: Delaware residents file lawsuit seeking a second House seat for the First State
headlines.description: They want a federal court to overturn the House’s 435-seat cap and create a second congressional district for Delaware.
